title: Block incomplete queue route previews
summary: Require a complete authoritative route decision before a queue row can enter accepted Run Once scope.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W03-008. A route resolver exception after successful destination naming currently leaves route identity empty but still increments runnable membership and fingerprints the row as accepted.
behavior_before: Route-resolution exceptions populate only display reason text; the later acceptance gate checks naming but not route validity, so incomplete rows can become runnable and accepted.
behavior_after: Route exceptions and incomplete or noncanonical route objects receive route_preview_failed evidence, clear stale route fields, disable deferred runtime-check claims, and cannot receive run indexes or accepted-plan membership.
tests_added: Injected route-resolver exception and incomplete-route fixtures prove the rows are blocked, have stable reason codes and zero runnable index, and remain absent from accepted Run Once membership.
The queue-engine harness now supplies complete contract-faithful route plans by default instead of accidentally relying on the production fail-open behavior.
manual_validation: Corrected pre-fix queue-engine fixture - expected red: the thrown and incomplete route decisions produced three runnable rows instead of one.
Post-fix Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks.ps1 - passed the full queue snapshot/engine wrapper with contract-faithful default route evidence and injected failure cases.
Media-route selection, route-explanation evidence, and library-profile routing PowerShell wrappers - passed against the actual route policy modules.
Queue snapshot, launch policy/preflight, process launch, and facade queue Python modules - passed: 93 tests and 45 subtests.
PowerShell parser and git diff whitespace checks passed for both changed source/test scripts.
Targeted refresh_summaries wrote three summaries; generate_project_index regenerated 2,478 typed records and the dependency graph; feature-file map and 15 feature cards regenerated.
Summary integrity, risky-file registry, lifecycle-map, feature-card, and AI-guardrail unit set - passed: 35 tests and 72 subtests.
Project-index, feature-map, risky-file registry, and architecture guardrails passed.
Global summary freshness reports only the same six pre-existing stale files outside this packet; every touched summary is current.

God-file guard remains red on two pre-existing maximum violations: snapshot_rows.ps1 was 1,018 lines at HEAD and is 1,056 after the focused 38-line gate; Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks.ps1 was 2,044 lines at HEAD and is 2,125 after 81 focused test lines. The guard was not weakened and a broad unrelated split was not folded into this safety batch.
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - passed with 1,143 valid packets before completion.
rollback_plan: Revert the route acceptance gate, focused queue parity fixtures, generated context, and packet metadata together; retain this packet as incomplete evidence if rollback occurs.
notes: High-risk queue preview/runtime routing boundary. This batch changes acceptance validation only, not Resolve-InitialMediaRoutePlan semantics or FFmpeg command generation. Required validation is queue snapshot/engine tests, Python launch-scope tests, and synthetic Run Once parity smoke. Representative real media is not required by the audit validation rung.
